messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Windows build
parts:
Ben and Jiqiang, are you able to build stanc under Windows using either g++ or clang++? To by-pass the Visual C++ compiler type:
make bin/stanc

Also, what versions are you running things on? I'm having trouble keeping track. Here's the Jenkins box:
- Windows 7 Enterprise. 64-bit.
- g++ 4.6.1 (tdm64-1). target: x86_64-w64-mingw32
- Visual Studio compiler: 32-bit 16.00.40219.01 for 80x86

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: Windows build
parts:
I don't have any Windows machines (aside from an ancient virtual machine that wouldn't have enough RAM for stan). But I can cross-compile on Linux for a Windows target (either 32 or 64 bits) when I do

make AR=/usr/bin/i686-w64-mingw32-ar CC=i686-w64-mingw32-g++ O=2 bin/stanc

or plain g++ or plain clang++ with , which compiles natively for Linux.

Ben
